title: Integer count
description: A whole number: a row count, an index, a precision digit count, a sequence number, a number of attempts. NEVER a decimal string and NEVER a float. Violations this contract fixes going forward: backend/data/internal/research/cryptorank/types.go encodes Rank/PairsCount/CurrenciesCount/WalletsCount/MarketsCount as *float64 (provider rank and counts carried in binary64). Correct pattern in the repo: backend/workers/executor/internal/idempotency/idempotency.go sequence numbers (strconv.Itoa) and instruments.Instrument.PricePrecision/QuantityPrecision/MaxLeverage (int).
